settings.heading: DELIVERY & PICKUP
settings.subtitle: YOUR SET IS GETTING READY TO ENTER YOUR SCENE
settings.introduction: Every order goes through our preparation process before it is ready for pickup or delivery. Choose the delivery method that works best for you at checkout.
settings.note_body: Please review your selected delivery method, any applicable delivery fee, and the pickup or delivery instructions before completing your order. Same-day and next-day delivery are available only where eligible.

settings.title: PROCESSING TIME
settings.description: Orders are processed in less than 24 hours.

settings.title: PICKUP
settings.description: Prefer to collect your order? Choose pickup at checkout and follow the instructions provided to arrange collection.

settings.title: NEXT-DAY DELIVERY
settings.description: Next-day delivery is available for $7 when your order and delivery location are eligible. Select this option at checkout when available.

settings.title: SAME-DAY DELIVERY
settings.description: Need your set today? Check checkout for same-day delivery availability and the applicable fee.
